item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We are clear: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will be used to cause a disaster that kills thousands of people. We must prevent that future, not race toward it.

2. We reject a race to superintelligence that puts human lives on the line. If it is built within the next 20 years, it will be used to cause a disaster that kills thousands. We demand prevention, accountability and enforceable limits.

3. We will not accept thousands of deaths as the price of technological progress. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will be used to cause a deadly disaster on that scale. We must act before it is built.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We face a stark choice about the future we are building. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will be used to cause a disaster that kills thousands of people. We refuse to treat those lives as an acceptable cost of innovation. We demand enforceable limits on development, independent oversight and accountability for the organisations driving this race. We cannot wait for a catastrophe before deciding that prevention matters. We must organise now, press our leaders to act and insist that public safety comes before commercial ambition. We have a responsibility to prevent this disaster—not merely explain it afterward.
